source.schema_reference: NASA/TP-2015-216046 Appendix A.1 and Table IX (https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20150023456/downloads/20150023456.pdf)

scope.note: 274 PSI rows are not the 284 tests stated by NASA/TP-2015-216046; difference unresolved (see data/metadata/flex_report_reconciliation.json). Results describe the 274 PSI rows only.

supersedes_interpretation_of: v0.1.0 (reports/flex_run_level/, outputs kept unchanged); see docs/11

multiple_comparisons.statement: Many strata were examined; no correction for multiple comparisons is applied and no coefficient is a test of significance. All strata are reported, none selected.

analysis_choices.min_n_meaning: reporting floor only; n >= 5 is not evidence of reliability
analysis_choices.pressure_cluster_justification: clusters identical for gap rules 25-200 mmHg and labelled by NASA nominal design levels 0.70/1.00/2.03/2.72/3.05 atm
analysis_choices.support_mode_stratification: every K and Dext stratum is split by support mode (free-floating, fiber translated, fiber translation not stated, conflicting sources)
analysis_choices.statistic: Spearman rank correlation (descriptive; no p-values, no regression, no prediction)
analysis_choices.compositional_rule: O2 only within N2-only runs; CO2/He only at fixed O2 (with N2-only zero-diluent runs at the same O2 and pressure cluster as reference)

invalid.source_conflict: Table IX/PSI 0 mmHg vs matrix Table VI 0.7 atm

sensitivity_reported_K_0.05_FLEX_130.context: Table IX value confirmed visually; caption: fiber-supported, translating 3 mm/s, very short burn, radiative extinction soon after translation began (burn time 0.6 s).

contamination_caveats.Methanol: NASA/TP-2015-216046 sec. 5.2 item 4: disruptive extinction of methanol is probably due to needle-coating contamination (all tests in the report used coated needles). Methanol disruption counts must not be read as a response to ambient conditions.
contamination_caveats.Heptane: sec. 5.2 item 5: heptane disruption may be due to the contaminant; NASA states no conclusion can be drawn regarding disruptive burning for heptane in these tests.
